text:
elaine (Finance Ops): Heads up — BetaCorp just reported two invoices for March. One invoice missing the 'Dedicated GPU compute' line entirely, the other is a duplicate with the numbers flipped (USD vs EUR) and both PDFs were emailed to the customer. Can someone triage? https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1234

matt (Billing Eng): ugh. I see a duplicate job run in Billing Engine v3 around 2026-03-15 02:03 UTC. Likely a retry that didn't clean up temp state. I'll pull logs.

sara (Revenue Ops): Customer flagged VAT on both invoices as 0% even though they have a valid EU VAT ID. They need corrected docs for accounting.

aditya (Accounting): We need the corrected invoice PDFs before EOD for BetaCorp to avoid payment delays. If refunds/credit notes are needed, please include reference to original invoice ids.

jen (Support): Customer message: "We received invoice #INV-2026-0321.pdf and INV-2026-0321-dup.pdf. One omits 'Dedicated compute' (charge ~ $9,200) and the other shows EUR 9,200 instead of USD 9,200. Which is correct?" 

billing-bot: Automated alert — invoice_generator:job-9891 retried (reason: transient storage timeout). Attached task ids: job-9891 / job-9891-retry.

matt (Billing Eng): Quick dump from logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:03:17Z INFO invoice_generator job-9891 started
2026-03-15T02:03:19Z ERROR storage PUT /invoices/tmp/INV-2026-0321.pdf ETag mismatch
2026-03-15T02:03:20Z WARN retrying job-9891-retry
2026-03-15T02:03:23Z INFO invoice_generator job-9891-retry completed (wrote INV-2026-0321.pdf)
2026-03-15T02:03:25Z INFO postprocess duplicate check skipped for job-9891-retry (flag: skip_dedup=true)
```
Looks like the retry skipped the duplicate-check path due to a transient flag — that explains duplicates. The missing line appears to be an upstream usage aggregation miss when the retry read a partial usage blob.

elaine (Finance Ops): Is this the same root cause as the February missing compute incident? (we had partial aggregation because of S3 multipart incomplete uploads)

matt (Billing Eng): Not identical, but related. February was S3 multipart; this one is a short window where the usage-aggregator write wasn't yet committed when the generator retried. Fixes: 1) ensure invoice job waits for usage-aggregator commit; 2) don't set skip_dedup on retries; 3) re-run invoice job for affected customers.

sara (Revenue Ops): Actionable: please re-issue corrected invoice with VAT applied and a credit note for the duplicate. CC'ing finance for approvals.

aditya (Accounting): Approve re-issue and credit note for BetaCorp. Please include both original invoice IDs and a short explanation in the PDF footer.

matt (Billing Eng): I'll queue a manual re-run for INV-2026-0321 with these steps:
- Ensure aggregator has commit marker for BetaCorp 2026-03-01..2026-03-31
- Run invoice_generator job-9891-reissue (dedup enforced)
- Generate credit note CN-2026-0007 referencing INV-2026-0321-dup

jen (Support): Customer reply: "Thanks — please confirm when new PDF is available. We need doc for auditors." :pray:

matt (Billing Eng): Putting a patch to prevent skip_dedup on retries to staging now. I'll run reissue once CI passes. ETA ~ 2.5 hours.

elaine (Finance Ops): Thanks. Could you also add a temporary check to mark any invoice missing 'Dedicated GPU compute' when expected (usage > 0) as 'blocked' before emailing? We had two separate sends to the customer which is bad.

matt (Billing Eng): Good call, adding pre-send validation. If a line is unexpectedly missing and usage shows >0 we will pause and create a BLOCKED ticket automatically.

sara (Revenue Ops): Also add a small audit note for customers who received duplicate PDFs so CS has text to send. Suggested: "We erroneously sent duplicate invoice documents due to a retry; please use the attached corrected invoice and credit note."

aditya (Accounting): Once reissued, send corrected invoice to billing@betacorp.com and cc: accounting@betacorp.com. We'll reconcile on our side.

matt (Billing Eng): Created internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-1234 (linked to CN-2026-0007). I'll post updates there.

jen (Support): Noted. I'll update the customer with ETA and add a temporary hold on payment processing until corrected invoice is received.

elaine (Finance Ops): Thanks all. Follow-up: please include the root cause and remediation summary in the ticket for the March monthly postmortem. :eyes:

matt (Billing Eng): Will do. cc @eng-sre in the ticket for storage/consistency review.
